questions.text: worker sees an immediate threat of collapse in its area. How to proceed?

options.text: Continue work until written instructions are received.
Stop work, leave the danger zone and immediately inform the supervisor in the prescribed manner.
Independently eliminate the threat without assessing or fencing.
Ask a colleague to observe while work continues.

questions.text: An employee injury has occurred. What is the correct first action by an eyewitness?

options.text: Immediately change the scene without requiring rescue.
Send the victim alone to fill out the documents.
Stop exposure to the hazard, call for help, provide all possible first aid and report the incident.
Finish the production operation first.

questions.text: Equipment safety guard is damaged. What must worker do?

options.text: Work only in the presence of a colleague.
Remove the remaining part of the guard and continue working.
Cover damage with cardboard without reporting.
Stop using the equipment and report the malfunction to the responsible person.

questions.text: Which measure should be considered before issuing additional PPE?

options.text: Removal of hazard or technical containment and isolation of source, if possible.
Increased shift duration.
Postponement of training to the end of work.
Replacement of the warning sign with a larger one without other measures.

questions.text: When is an employee allowed to work independently?

options.text: After a verbal introduction to a colleague.
After the first independent operation.
After the required training, instruction, knowledge testing and other established tolerances for his work.
Immediately after signing the report card.

questions.text: Who ensures that the required PPE is issued to the employee?

options.text: Any visitor to the work site.
The worker personally, by being required to buy it from any store.
OEM only.
employer in accordance with risks, regulations and established procedures.

questions.text: Gas hazardous work is planned at a hazardous production facility. What is needed before you start?

options.text: Start work after verbal consent from your closest colleague.
Organize the work under the established procedure and permit-to-work, with atmosphere analysis, protective measures and emergency readiness.
Check the atmosphere by smell.
Turn off the alarm so that it does not interfere.

questions.text: How should worker act upon an emergency signal at a hazardous production facility?

options.text: Stop work, carry out the actions provided for in the plan, leave or take a safe place and report via established communication.
Continue work until instructed by a colleague.
Return for personal items after leaving.
Change the evacuation route independently without reason.

questions.text: There is no permit marking before working with pressure equipment and the status is unclear. What to do?

options.text: Open the fitting with blows of the tool.
Turn on minimum pressure for testing.
Apply the date yourself with a marker.
Do not turn on the equipment and request confirmation of approval and technical condition from the responsible person.

questions.text: What is a hazardous production facility?

options.text: Any room where more than two people work.
Fire station building only.
An object identified by legally established signs of the presence of hazardous substances, processes or technical devices.
Any territory with access control.

questions.text: The employee was assigned to perform an operation for which he was not trained to perform safely. What should I do?

options.text: Sign the journal after completing the work.
Transfer the operation to another untrained employee.
Perform the operation following the example of a colleague without instructions.
Do not start the operation and inform the supervisor about the need for training and clearance.

questions.text: Occurred incident without injury, but there could have been a serious consequence. What should I do?

options.text: Report the incident, retain available information and participate in the analysis of causes and preventive measures.
Discuss the case only informally after the shift.
Do not report because no one was injured.
Delete entries so you don't have to stop working.

questions.text: worker observed a spill of an unknown substance. How to proceed?

options.text: Check the substance for smell at close range.
Fence off or leave the danger zone as appropriate and report, without proceeding with liquidation without preparation and means.
Flush spill down drain.
Collect the substance with bare hands in an ordinary container.

questions.text: Dangerous dust constantly appears in the area. Which approach corresponds to the hierarchy of control?

options.text: Remove dust with a dry broom while working.
Consider the warning label as sufficient protection.
Limit the issuance of disposable masks without evaluation.
Consider process elimination or replacement and dust removal engineering first, then organizational measures and PPE.

questions.text: Is training automatically transferred whenever an employee transfers?

options.text: The decision is made by worker himself without the employer’s documents.
Yes, retraining is prohibited for any transfer.
The procedure is determined by employer according to the current rules, taking into account the profession, work and conditions; non-repetition is possible only in the intended case.
No, learning always repeats regardless of conditions.

questions.text: What must worker do with the issued PPE?

options.text: Change the design for convenience without approval.
Use correctly, check before use, take care of it and report any defects.
Transfer them to any person without regard to size or purpose.
Use faulty PPE until new ones are received.

questions.text: An odor resembling hydrogen sulfide was detected and the gas detector alarm activated. What should be done?

options.text: Immediately leave the danger zone along the route, warn others and report in an emergency.
Continue working with the door open.
Look for leaks alone without breathing protection.
Remove the protection to more accurately determine the smell.

questions.text: What is the purpose of an emergency response plan?

options.text: Determine the wages of the emergency group.
Replace equipment maintenance.
Establish a routine cleaning schedule.
Determine in advance the notification, personnel actions, management and resources to contain the accident and protect people.

questions.text: Gas analysis was not performed before entering the tank. What should I do?

options.text: Enter briefly while holding your breath.
Check the air with a burning match.
Do not enter until procedure is completed, environmental analysis, ventilation, observation and readiness for rescue are complete.
Allow one employee to enter without an observer.

questions.text: What does incident mean in industrial safety?

options.text: Any written remark to the employee.
Failure, damage or deviation at a hazardous production facility that violated the safe operation of the process, but did not reach signs of an accident.
Only occupational accident out of production.
Any planned stop for lunch.

questions.text: A life-threatening hazard suddenly arises in the work area. How is the right to safe work exercised?

options.text: worker stops operation and notifies the identified responsible person of the imminent threat.
worker hides hazard until the scheduled meeting.
worker leaves the organization without notice.
worker continues to work if the shift is almost over.

questions.text: After the incident, you need to maintain the situation. When is it permissible to change it?

options.text: Always immediately after an incident for quick cleanup.
Only for the sake of continuing the production plan.
At the request of any witness without documentation.
When necessary to save people, prevent further danger or as directed by responsible services with recording of changes.

questions.text: The tool began producing an unusual noise and vibration. What is required?

options.text: Continue until scheduled break.
Transfer a working tool to a colleague without explanation.
Stop operation, unplug tool safely and report fault.
Increase load to check power.

questions.text: Dangerous movement of the mechanism can be physically isolated. Which control is preferable?

options.text: Only issue gloves regardless of risk of entrapment.
Install serviceable technical fencing with the provided interlocks.
Just remind employees to be more careful.
Just reduce the time you spend nearby.

questions.text: Why is target safety briefing carried out?

options.text: For specific one-time or dangerous work and the conditions for its safe performance in specified cases.
To replace all types of vocational training.
For vacation schedule information only.
For permission to operate faulty equipment.

questions.text: Why is collective protection usually considered before individual protection?

options.text: It is always cheaper than any other solution.
It is only used after an accident.
It reduces the impact of a hazard on a group of people at once and is less dependent on the behavior of each individual.
It allows you to cancel staff training.

questions.text: Before hot work at the hazardous production facility, flammable materials were not removed. Which decision is correct?

options.text: Ask one worker to observe without extinguishing equipment.
Start work by placing a bucket of water nearby.
Cover the materials with paper.
Do not start work until the work permit measures have been completed and the fireproof area has been prepared.

questions.text: What is checked during emergency training?

options.text: Understand signals, routes, roles, communications and practical actions without creating actual danger.
Timesheet filling speed only.
Only knowledge of the manager’s office number.
Casual clothing only.

questions.text: The gas analyzer showed a value above the established safe limit. How to proceed?

options.text: Turn off the device and focus on how you feel.
Do not start or stop work, exit the area and carry out emergency and control measures according to the procedure.
Pass the device to another worker and remain in the area.
Continue working at a faster pace.

questions.text: What does the abbreviation PLA stand for?

options.text: Planned sheet reinforcement.
List of personal leaves of administration.
Emergency response plan defining organized actions in case of an emergency.
Laboratory analysis passport.
